titleEn: Find Resultant Array After Removing Anagrams
title: 移除字母异位词后的结果数组
summary: 反复删除与前一个单词互为字母异位词的单词，返回最终数组。
insight: 删除只会让当前词与最近保留词相邻；顺序扫描，比较排序字符签名，签名相同则跳过，否则保留并更新签名。
pitfalls: 只与删除过程后的前一个保留词比较
单词本身顺序需原样返回
连续多个同签名只保留第一个

solutions.title: 最近保留词签名扫描
solutions.idea: 在线模拟删除后的相邻关系。
steps: 对 word 求排序字符 signature
signature!=previous 时保留 word 并更新 previous；否则跳过

code.java: class Solution { private String signature(String word){char[] chars=word.toCharArray();Arrays.sort(chars);return new String(chars);}public List<String> removeAnagrams(String[] words){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();String previous="";for(String word:words){String current=signature(word);if(!current.equals(previous)){answer.add(word);previous=current;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun removeAnagrams(words:Array<String>):List<String>{val answer=mutableListOf<String>();var previous="";for(word in words){val current=word.toCharArray().sorted().joinToString("");if(current!=previous){answer.add(word);previous=current}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<string> removeAnagrams(vector<string>& words){vector<string> answer;string previous;for(string& word:words){string current=word;sort(current.begin(),current.end());if(current!=previous){answer.push_back(word);previous=current;}}return answer;} };
